recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-27752. If equivalent RequestOrchestration.action relatedData cardinality changes are desired, handle them separately under the RequestOrchestration/FHIR-34265 change family rather than broadening this PlanDefinition reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-27752 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It originally asked for an optional DataRequirement.name, but the accepted resolution rejected changing DataRequirement and instead required PlanDefinition.action.input and PlanDefinition.action.output to become complex structures with title, requirement, repeatable relatedRequirementId-style references, and an invariant requiring requirement or related references but not both.
initial_application: Git commit 2101fd4e461a2575b43cec5794ba34de835f61a1 (J#27752) applied most of the issue by changing active PlanDefinition action input/output from direct DataRequirement arrays to BackboneElement arrays with title, requirement, relatedData, and exclusive-or constraints. That application used the current relatedData name rather than relatedRequirementId, but left each relatedData at max 1 despite the final Jira resolution's 0..* cardinality. Later cleanup removed XPath constraints, and FHIR-40218 corrected PlanDefinition.action.input.relatedData to string because Element.id is string.
additional_context: PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml is the authoritative build-scope resource source. The current source already correctly avoids DataRequirement.name and includes title, requirement, relatedData, and xor constraints. CDS WGM minutes record approval of FHIR-27752 and Workflow minutes record the proposal rewrite. Later Zulip discussions confirm relatedData is used for PlanDefinition action data flow. FHIR-34265 copied similar definitional action aspects into RequestGroup/RequestOrchestration, but that separate tracker was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml so PlanDefinition.action.input.relatedData and PlanDefinition.action.output.relatedData have max "*" instead of max "1". The commit preserved the later FHIR-40218 string type and the existing xor constraints.

related_jiras.note: Applied later technical correction changed PlanDefinition.action.input.relatedData to string because Element.id is string; this reconciliation preserved that type decision.
Published change that added PlanDefinition-like definitional action aspects to RequestGroup/RequestOrchestration; relevant parallel history, but not part of this PlanDefinition seed fix.
